experiment: C6 exploratory two-level hierarchical Canaria recompilation

conditions.hierarchical_no_level2_adapt: freeze independently recompiled C12,C34 and fit C1234 on C34(C12(a0)) only
conditions.hierarchical_level2_joint_adapt: jointly adapt [C12,C34] to lower_ir_full_teacher only, freeze, then fit C1234 on adapted pair outputs only
conditions.direct_original_single: fit matched C1234 directly to original a0->a4 reference

final_single_fairness: all final C1234 conditions use identical initialization seed and minibatch RNG seed within a teacher seed
endpoints: lower IR full teacher validation NMSE vs original a4
C12 and C34 NMSE vs immediate frozen pair-cluster teachers
pre-level2 pair composition NMSE vs lower IR and original
post-level2 joint-adapted pair composition NMSE vs lower IR and original
final C1234 NMSE vs immediate Canaria teacher
final C1234 NMSE vs original a4
claim_boundary: Exploratory depth-two evidence only. No held-out test, no arbitrary-depth claim, no lossless claim, no architecture universality claim.
